nodes.label: Web app PWA HTML shell
nodes.rationale: Viewport pins maximum-scale=1 with viewport-fit=cover and interactive-widget=resizes-content so the chat UI behaves like a native app on mobile keyboards and notched displays. The <title> is a {{PRODUCT_NAME}} build-time placeholder.

nodes.label: Inline color-mode bootstrap script
nodes.rationale: Reads localStorage 'color-mode' (falling back to prefers-color-scheme) and stamps .dark on <html> synchronously before the module bundle loads, so the app never flashes a light theme on startup.

nodes.label: #app-loading pre-hydration spinner
nodes.rationale: A dark full-height spinner is inlined inside #app so the mount point shows something during module download and is replaced when Vue mounts — no external asset, no extra request.
